entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a few weeks and it's a piece of junk. I want my money back.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse, sir. I can certainly look into your return options. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
It's David Chen, order number 774-B2. Look, this thing is just not intuitive. It's so **hard to use**, I can't believe you guys even shipped it like this.
I understand your frustration, Mr. Chen. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference on how it functions?

What kind of a question is that? It's a fault in your design! The whole menu system is **confusing**, and frankly, I **expected more** from a brand like VeloFit. I even tried reading the **user manual**, and it was no help at all. Are you going to process this return or do I need to talk to your manager and start posting reviews?
There's no need for that, sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order details and review the policy. One moment, please.
Okay, Mr. Chen, I see your order was delivered 30 days ago. I'm just checking our internal return policy now...

Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and approve a full refund for you. I'll email a prepaid shipping label to you right now.
Oh. So, you're just taking it back? No problem?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll process your refund back to the original payment method. That usually takes 3 to 5 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy.
You're very welcome, Mr. Chen. The email with that label has been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
